glosses: arrival (act of arriving or something that has arrived)

examples.text: O acidente aconteceu antes da minha chegada.
examples.en: The accident happened previous to my arrival.

examples.text: É chegada a hora de agir.
examples.en: The time has come to act.

examples.text: Ele saiu logo após a nossa chegada.
examples.en: He left soon after our arrival.
His arrival pepped up the party.

examples.text: Vi a hora de chegada no horário.
examples.en: I looked up the arrival time in the timetable.
